Short Detail

Short Detail

By:The Local Norway - 7 June,2019

Short Detail

RBI removes charges on RTGS/NEFT transactions; asks banks to pass on benefits

By:The Hindu - 6 June,2019

Short Detail

The Reserve Bank of India(RBI) has removed the charges levied on Real Time Gross Settlement (RTGS) and National Electronic Funds Transfer (NEFT) transactions to boost digital payments.

At present, the banks levy minimum charges for transactions done through RTGS system for large-value (Rs 2 lakh and above) instantaneous fund transfers and NEFT System for other fund transfers (below Rs 2 lakh).

Yet again, Mumbai most congested in world, finds study

By:The Hindu - 5 June,2019

Short Detail

The TomTom Traffic Index 2018, carried out by location technology specialist TomTom, covered 403 cities in 56 countries and defined congestion as the extra time added to road travel when traffic doesn’t flow freely. Mumbai topped the list of cities with drivers expecting to spend an average of 65% extra travel time stuck in traffic. New Delhi ranked fourth with a congestion rank of 58%. Bogota (63%) in Colombia and Lima in Peru (58%) were ranked second and third on the list respectively, while the Russian capital Moscow (56%) ranked fifth.

Traffic Index 2018. Source:prokerala.com

Equator Prize 2019 winners announced for local innovative climate solutions

By:United Nations Development Programme - 5 June,2019

Short Detail

The United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) and partners announced the winners of the10th Equator Prize 2019. It recognized 22 local and indigenous communities from across the world.The winners were selected from a pool of 847 nominations across 127 countries in a four-stage selection process by an independent Technical Advisory Committee of internationally renowned experts.

Telangana-based NGO won UN’s Equator Prize 2019. Source:undp.org

Winners will each receive $10,000 and the opportunity for two community representatives to join a week-long summit in New York during the 74th United Nations General Assembly (UNGA).

The award ceremony will be on 24 September 2019.

Telangana-based NGO,The women sangams (groups) of the Deccan Development Society (DDS) bagged the United Nation’s Equator Prize for 2019.

China successfully launches its Long March-11 rocket from sea for first time

By:Livemint - 5 June,2019

Short Detail

China launched a space rocket from sea for the first time,the latest step in Beijing's push to become a major space power..The Asian giant now spends more than Russia and Japan on its civil and military space programmes—unveiling ambitious plans for missions to the moon and beyond in the coming decade.

Long March-11 rocket. Source:spacetechasia.com

A Long March 11 rocket was launched from a ship in the Yellow Sea just after midday, the China National Space Administration said in a statement.

With this achievement, China joined the U.S. and Russia as the 3 global powers with proven ability to launch rockets into space from the sea.
